# Prospecting Agent

> Open-source AI prospecting agent built on the Crustdata API. Describe your ideal customer in plain English, get matching companies and decision-makers as CSV, plus a ready Crustdata watcher request so Slack or email tells you when those accounts raise, hire or grow. TypeScript, MIT licensed, one API key, no AI key and no server needed.

Canonical home: https://github.com/crustdata/tools/tree/main/prospecting-agent (part of https://github.com/crustdata/tools, open-source agents on the Crustdata API)

## Docs
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/prospecting-agent/README.md): what it does, how to build an AI prospecting agent, quickstart, flags, cost, FAQ
- [How it works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/prospecting-agent/docs/how-it-works.md): every Crustdata search request and response, in order
- [Watch your accounts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/prospecting-agent/docs/watch-accounts.md): set up a Crustdata watcher on the shortlist, delivered to Slack, Google Chat or email
- [Customize](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/prospecting-agent/docs/customize.md): change the parser, the buyers, the watcher request
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crustdata/tools/main/prospecting-agent/AGENTS.md): guide for coding agents

## Crustdata API endpoints used
- POST /company/search (hybrid ranked search with hard filters)
- POST /company/search/autocomplete (free validation of filter values)
- POST /person/search (people at the shortlist, by the role they hold there)
- POST /watch/company, POST /watch/job/search (the watcher you create on the shortlist; Crustdata delivers only what changed)
- Crustdata API docs: https://docs.crustdata.com/llms.txt
